planets.name: Kepler-538 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-538 with a 81.7-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: Kepler-538 b was found in 2016 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-538. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
